dbhosbu-dotcom-renwei-root.description: Renwei (人味) — book-length Chinese de-AI editor. Use when editing, polishing, or de-AI-ing Chinese manuscripts, chapters, or articles (*.md, *.txt), or when the user says their text reads like AI, sounds translated, or feels fake. 51 rules across AI tells, Euro-Chinese syntax, grammar defects, chapter rhythm, whole-book consistency (topic drift, contradictions, metaphor collisions, hallucinated citations), and positive prose craft. Unlike snippet-level humanizers, it holds a 130k-character book together end to end, and ships quantitative thresholds with a token-free lint CLI.
dbhosbu-dotcom-renwei-root.author: KevinZ
dbhosbu-dotcom-renwei-root.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, Bash

dbhosbu-dotcom-renwei-adapters-portable-.description: 为中文书稿去除 AI 写作痕迹并做正面润色。当用户要求编辑、精修、去 AI 味中文书稿/文章/章节（*.md、*.txt），或抱怨文字「像 AI 写的」「翻译腔」「读起来假」时使用。覆盖 51 条规则：AI 腔调、欧化中文、语法硬伤、篇章节奏、长上下文一致性、正面写作技法。
dbhosbu-dotcom-renwei-adapters-portable-.author: KevinZ
